The same detector fires on the bare goal locative 'home' after a motion verb ('came/gone/drove home') and on completion/phase adverbs that mark where a situation stands ('already', 'yet', 'shortly') - the locative and temporal instances of the same 'specific entity or situation undergoing a change' feature.
